BLUESPITE PORTABLE - START HERE
========================================

1. Extract the whole BlueSPite-Portable folder before using it.
2. Double-click BlueSPite.exe. No Node.js or installer is required.
3. Keep runtime, app, and extension beside BlueSPite.exe.

CHROME EXTENSION - FIRST TIME ONLY
1. Open chrome://extensions in Chrome.
2. Turn on Developer mode.
3. Click Load unpacked and choose this package's extension folder.
4. Keep Chrome open, then run BlueSPite.exe.

PORTABLE DATA
- Settings/history are saved in the data folder.
- Generated images/videos are saved in the Generated Media folder.
- Copy the whole folder to move the app and its data to another PC.
